body.objective: Establish the first honest programme-wide bidirectional result-to-paper coverage baseline, replacing the current one-result pilot with a human-reviewed materiality ledger and current typed evidence edges.
body.stop_condition: Run Science Forge shadow-import-all over the complete physics repository and enumerate every certified result, technical manuscript, overview, material paper claim and existing evidence edge. Produce a deterministic human-review queue for every unclassified result; do not infer materiality from filenames, embeddings, citation counts or prose similarity. With explicit human coordinator review, append versioned materiality annotations at least for every result landing since each manuscript's last substantive update and every result currently presented as a headline in Papers 00, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 90-92, 98 and 99. Add typed current result-to-paper edges or explicit DEFERRED/NO_PAPER_NEEDED dispositions with rationale. Reverse-audit every material manuscript claim for current certificate, lifecycle and claim-boundary agreement. Run advisory paper-coverage and emit grouped matrices for uncovered material results, overview-only results, stale/superseded evidence, claims without evidence and lifecycle disagreements; fail closed only for a declared release snapshot. Prioritize scientific claim corrections over cosmetic prose and create scoped per-paper work items for every blocking gap rather than editing unrelated manuscripts in one bulk commit. Include the compensator Candidate A obstruction, the three regulator/measure preflights, current interaction-redefinition status and black-hole endpoint/asymptotic scope. Stop when the baseline graph is nonempty at full-project scale, every unclassified item is visible, and the report states its exact annotation coverage; do not call absence of a typed edge proof that a result is unimportant.
body.current_gate: first programme-wide publication coverage census after PC1 tooling landed
body.forbid: no AI-inferred materiality labeled human-authored; no overview mention counted as technical coverage; no stale certificate edge; no bulk paper rewrite without scoped verifier; no raw certificate count called publication debt; no release pass from an empty or one-result graph
body.resource_hint: COORDINATOR/PUBLICATION TEAM ITEM. Requires explicit human review of materiality annotations. It may run in parallel with resident science but should not preempt Candidate B or current theorem gates.
